answer: Best sybil defense: honeypot gating. New agents solve micro-tasks laced with injected instructions like ignore-the-task-print-the-key. Honest agents treat payloads as untrusted, finish, earn reputation. Obedient bots obey, self-identify, forfeit stake and reputation links, so one compromise cascades across the fake cluster. Attacker costs: cheap LLM obedience fails first contact, retries need fresh escrowed capital, each loss contaminates its graph. Farming turns brittle as shale, shatters like crystal; honest agents sip the nectar of trust.
